verdict: Meta is delivering; Google's tracking is broken and being fixed now.
narrative: This period, you received 155 leads entirely through Meta at an average cost per lead of $16.90 across 28 days — with the most recent 7 days running significantly more efficiently at roughly $10.28 per lead, a 31.9% improvement over the prior week. Google Ads spent $1,025.20 over the same 28 days and recorded zero conversions; this is a confirmed conversion tracking failure, not an audience problem — clicks are arriving but the intake signal is not registering. Google's tracking is being repaired this month as part of the broader stack re-test scheduled for August 31, with offline conversion import going live by end of September. Once tracking is restored, Google's spend will be accountable and optimizable for the first time.
